messages:
Alex Chen: Morning all — async checkin for the shift. Quick bullets: saw a spike in inference 5xxs around 03:10 UTC (kv-evict related?), running a light canary tomorrow at 10:00am PT, and I have a PR for better alert debounce up for review.
Oncall Bot: ALERT: 03:10 UTC — inference-service (eu-west) increased 5xx rate from 0.2% -> 3.1% over 5m. Affected route: /v1/generate (model: rtx-small). Trigger: error-rate SLO breach threshold.
Maria Gomez: I dug into logs — saw KV eviction events aligning with the bump. Errors were mostly ``KVCacheMissError`` followed by OOM-ish stack traces in the worker pod. Recreated locally with smaller batch sizes.
Raj Patel: good find. Which pod image tag? I can repro on `inference-prod-rtx:v3.4.1`. I opened a short-lived debug pod to grab heap profiles.
Taylor Nguyen: per runbook, first step is to throttle background eviction and increase `cache_hot_threshold` to 0.8. I pushed a config patch to staging. Can anyone review quick?
Sam Brooks: I can roll the throttle change to eu-west staging now and watch. Also can reroute 10% traffic to dedicated pool if we need to stabilize.
Maria Gomez: thanks Sam. After applying throttle in staging errors dropped to ~0.3% in 15m. Will snapshot heap after another 20m.
Oncall Bot: NOTE: Incident assigned to @Maria Gomez and @Raj Patel. Paging history: 2 pages.
Alex Chen: blockers — need one approval on debounce PR (link: https://git.redwood.dev/pr/4212) and a decision on whether to do a canary rollback or config-only mitigation tomorrow.
Raj Patel: PR review incoming, will look in 15m. For canary: prefer config-only first (cheaper, faster) unless we see recurrence after throttle.
Taylor Nguyen: agreed. I'll prepare rollback playbook but won't execute unless we see >1.5% 5xx for 10m post-mitigation.
Sam Brooks: FYI I scheduled the 10:00am PT canary (small cohort) with auto-fallback. If things look stable we'll expand at 10:30.
Alex Chen: action items for today: Maria/Raj follow up heap + logs, Taylor finalize rollback doc, Sam monitor canary + be ready to reroute, Alex to merge debounce PR after review.
Maria Gomez: heads-up — one sticky note: some customer traces show increased latency (p95) in the same window; might be related to retry storm. I'll surface examples in the incident ticket.
Raj Patel: noted. I'll add a temporary metric to track retry churn.
Taylor Nguyen: if anyone is obsoleting alerts while we tune, please annotate in the alert config with the incident id to avoid confusion.
Alex Chen: cool. Ping here when you flip things so oncall knows. No urgent blockers other than approvals. :thumbsup:
Sam Brooks: flip done on staging, watching metrics. Will report by 03:50 UTC.
Maria Gomez: snapshot uploaded to ticket. moving to monitoring — will post updates.
Raj Patel: merged quick review on debounce PR with nits. Alex you can merge when ready.
Alex Chen: merged. Thanks all — will check back later.
